# The list arrives in the pagination envelope — empty in this committee

**Claim.** Survey questions come back in the standard `{items, count, nextPageLink}` envelope. The sandbox committee has no survey questions (and none can be created — every `type` is rejected), so the empty page is the only response this database can produce.

Applies to: `~1surveyQuestions/get`

## Observed exchange

_No filters: the default is Active questions, of which this committee has none._

```http
GET /surveyQuestions

→ 200
```
